newsitem.title: DUBAI: BOXING-EUBANK PLANS BOUT IN DUBAI, THEN TILT AT TITLE.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-EUBANK PLANS BOUT IN DUBAI, THEN TILT AT TITLE.

text.p: Former World Boxing Organisation (WBO) middleweight and super-middleweight champion Chris Eubank said he planned to fight in Dubai on March 27.
"That is the tentative date but the bout at the end of March here in Dubai is confirmed," Eubank was reported by Dubai newspapers on Tuesday as saying.
The Briton, who was on a visit to Dubai, did not name his opponent.
Eubank retired from boxing in 1995 but started his comeback in Cairo last October with a defeat of Argentine Louis Barrera.
He said he hoped to have a shot at the world title if he won the fight in March.
